notes: [New] Seasonal Events have been added: limited-time events that run on a yearly date window or by admin command.
[New] Halloween Hunt is the first event pack and starts automatically from Oct 24 to Nov 2 (dates are configurable).
[New] During Halloween, ghost, dark and poison creatures spawn more often and shiny odds are doubled.
[New] Ghost, dark and poison creatures can now appear in roaming spawns while the event is active.
[New] 9 new event-only creatures in 3 evolution lines have been added
[Improved] The app switches to a Halloween theme with an event banner, countdown and bats over the map.
[Improved] During Halloween the map turns into a darker night map, with matching map buttons and an orange catch-range circle.
[Improved] The weather popup now shows which types are boosted by the active event
